text:
Sam: quick thread — the console "preview recipients" card is misleading. customers assume it will actually trigger pages. we should decide: make it a live dry-run or just a computed view.
Jun: i'd vote computed-only. live dry-run implies risk (accidental pages) and more infra. computed preview + clear copy should be enough.
Priya: computed-only sounds safer, but we need to surface _why_ someone would/ wouldn't be in the list (e.g., quiet window, per-tenant override, escalation step). otherwise it's not useful for debugging.
Sam: agreed. design asks for an "explanation" line per recipient. e.g., "oncall-team (PagerDuty) — escalation step 1" or "infra-owner (email) — owner override".
Jun: implementation note: don't duplicate routing logic in console. routing-service already has endpoints to resolve fanout. propose `GET /api/v1/routing/preview?rule=<id>&time=<iso>&seed=<int>` that returns recipients + suppressed + decision_reasons. include deterministic sampling via seed param for rollouts.
Priya: ACLs — only tenant admins + members with notify-preview role can call. also annotate the call with `x-preview=true` header so pipeline treats it as non-alert telemetry.
Marta: ops: caching is important. preview calls could spike during a rollout. cache key = (tenant, rule_id, time_bucket, seed, preview_flag). short TTL 20s. and rate-limit per-tenant.
Sam: telemetry: add fields `preview:true`, `preview_seed:1234`, `preview_actor:userid`. store audit row for compliance: who ran preview, when, what rule, response hash.
Jun: UI nuance: show when a recipient is suppressed and why, and show a subtle warning if the rule is under sampling (e.g., "10% rollout — preview shows 1/10 targets"). also allow "simulate full fanout" toggle for admins (expensive).
Priya: edgecase: if routing depends on live incident state (owner currently on-call vs handover), the preview should use the same oncall snapshot as at `time` param. routing-service must accept `at=` to pin state.
Marta: agree. for determinism we'd need to freeze oncall snapshot + seed. cost estimate: lightweight queries, caching, shouldn't need new infra.
Sam: can someone spin up a small RFC? include API shape, ACLs, cache rules, telemetry schema, UI copy. i'll own the rollout plan.
ops-bot: created PLAT-4899: routing preview API + console integration — https://issues/redwood/PLAT-4899
Jun: I'll start the RFC draft. Priya — can you draft the UI copy?
Priya: on it. will include tooltip language: "This is a computed preview — no pages will be sent. It shows who _would_ be notified if this alert fired at the selected time."
Sam: perfect. aim to land a minimal read-only preview before next week's canary.
